findings.text: The company was incorporated on 8 December 2009 and has 12 current officers, comprising 11 directors and 1 other officer.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
Accounts were last made up to 30 November 2025 and are not overdue; the next accounts are due 31 May 2027.
The confirmation statement was last made up to 19 June 2026 and is not overdue; the next is due 3 July 2027.
The register holds 7 charges in total: 5 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 2 satisfied.
Across the 5 current directors checked, 99 other companies were found, of which 2 are in liquidation and 2 in administration; only the first 5 of 11 current directors were checked.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.
Since 24 October 2025, one director was appointed (PERSON 602, 1 February 2026) and three officers resigned, and no registered office address changes were filed.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 590 (91000591) is an active company with accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, no insolvency record, and 5 outstanding charges on file.
